Anything else (MAX_TOKENS, SAFETY, RECITATION, OTHER, missing finishReason, no candidates) is a provider failure ("Gemini didn't return a complete transcript."), whatever text came back, so the audio is kept for Retry. STOP with empty text = empty transcript.
S2 (HIGH) Transcription provider errors (ElevenLabs, Gemini, Deepgram): what reaches diagnostics/logs is only provider, model, HTTP status and a fixed reason; never response-body text.
